verses.en: L. M

verses.ar: اَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ اَنۡ يُّتۡرَكُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفۡتَنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do men think that they will be left alone on saying, "We believe", and that they will not be tested

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ صَدَقُوۡا وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: We did test those before them, and Allah will certainly know those who are true from those who are false

verses.ar: اَمۡ حَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنۡ يَّسۡبِقُوۡنَاؕ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do those who practise evil think that they will get the better of Us? Evil is their judgment

verses.ar: مَنۡ كَانَ يَرۡجُوۡا لِقَآءَ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ لَاٰتٍؕ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: For those whose hopes are in the meeting with Allah (in the Hereafter, let them strive); for the term (appointed) by Allah is surely coming and He hears and knows (all things)

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ جٰهَدَ فَاِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهٖؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And if any strive (with might and main), they do so for their own souls: for Allah is free of all needs from all creation

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ اَحۡسَنَ الَّذِيۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who believe and work righteous deeds,- from them shall We blot out all evil (that may be) in them, and We shall reward them according to the best of their deeds

verses.ar: وَوَصَّيۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ بِوَالِدَيۡهِ حُسۡنًاؕ وَاِنۡ جٰهَدٰكَ لِتُشۡرِكَ بِيۡ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَاؕ اِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَاُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: We have enjoined on man kindness to parents: but if they (either of them) strive (to force) thee to join with Me (in worship) anything of which thou hast no knowledge, obey them not. Ye have (all) to return to me, and I will tell you (the truth) of all that ye did

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ فِي الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: And those who believe and work righteous deeds,- them shall We admit to the company of the Righteous

verses.ar: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ فَاِذَا٘ اُوۡذِيَ فِي اللّٰهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللّٰهِؕ وَلَئِنۡ جَآءَ نَصۡرٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡؕ اَوَلَيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then there are among men such as say, "We believe in Allah"; but when they suffer affliction in (the cause of) Allah, they treat men's oppression as if it were the Wrath of Allah! And if help comes (to thee) from thy Lord, they are sure to say, "We have (always) been with you!" Does not Allah know best all that is in the hearts of all creation

verses.ar: وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ الۡمُنٰفِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: And Allah most certainly knows those who believe, and as certainly those who are Hypocrites

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبِعُوۡا سَبِيۡلَنَا وَلۡنَحۡمِلۡ خَطٰيٰكُمۡؕ وَمَا هُمۡ بِحٰمِلِيۡنَ مِنۡ خَطٰيٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّهُمۡ لَكٰذِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: And the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Follow our path, and we will bear (the consequences) of your faults." Never in the least will they bear their faults: in fact they are liars

verses.ar: وَلَيَحۡمِلُنَّ اَثۡقَالَهُمۡ وَاَثۡقَالًا مَّعَ اَثۡقَالِهِمۡؗ وَلَيُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: They will bear their own burdens, and (other) burdens along with their own, and on the Day of Judgments they will be called to account for their falsehoods

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ فَلَبِثَ فِيۡهِمۡ اَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ اِلَّا خَمۡسِيۡنَ عَامًاؕ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوۡفَانُ وَهُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: We (once) sent Noah to his people, and he tarried among them a thousand years less fifty: but the Deluge overwhelmed them while they (persisted in) sin

verses.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَاَصۡحٰبَ السَّفِيۡنَةِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا٘ اٰيَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: But We saved him and the companions of the Ark, and We made the (Ark) a Sign for all peoples

verses.ar: وَاِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُؕ ذٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And (We also saved) Abraham: behold, he said to his people, "Serve Allah and fear Him: that will be best for you- If ye understand

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡثَانًا وَّتَخۡلُقُوۡنَ اِفۡكًاؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ لَكُمۡ رِزۡقًا فَابۡتَغُوۡا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ الرِّزۡقَ وَاعۡبُدُوۡهُ وَاشۡكُرُوۡا لَهٗؕ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: For ye do worship idols besides Allah, and ye invent falsehood. The things that ye worship besides Allah have no power to give you sustenance: then seek ye sustenance from Allah, serve Him, and be grateful to Him: to Him will be your return

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ تُكَذِّبُوۡا فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ اُمَمٌ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡؕ وَمَا عَلَي الرَّسُوۡلِ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
verses.en: And if ye reject (the Message), so did generations before you: and the duty of the messenger is only to preach publicly (and clearly)

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ يُبۡدِئُ اللّٰهُ الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ يَسِيۡرٌ
verses.en: See they not how Allah originates creation, then repeats it: truly that is easy for Allah

verses.ar: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ بَدَاَ الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ اللّٰهُ يُنۡشِئُ النَّشۡاَةَ الۡاٰخِرَةَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌۚ‏
verses.en: Say: "Travel through the earth and see how Allah did originate creation; so will Allah produce a later creation: for Allah has power over all things

verses.ar: يُعَذِّبُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَرۡحَمُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُقۡلَبُوۡنَ
verses.en: He punishes whom He pleases, and He grants Mercy to whom He pleases, and towards Him are ye turned

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِؗ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Not on earth nor in heaven will ye be able (fleeing) to frustrate (his Plan), nor have ye, besides Allah, any protector or helper

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَلِقَآئِهٖ٘ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوۡا مِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِيۡ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: Those who reject the Signs of Allah and the Meeting with Him (in the Hereafter),- it is they who shall despair of My Mercy: it is they who will (suffer) a most grievous Penalty

verses.ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوا اقۡتُلُوۡهُ اَوۡ حَرِّقُوۡهُ فَاَنۡجٰىهُ اللّٰهُ مِنَ النَّارِؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: So naught was the answer of (Abraham's) people except that they said: "Slay him or burn him." But Allah did save him from the Fire. Verily in this are Signs for people who believe

verses.ar: وَقَالَ اِنَّمَا اتَّخَذۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡثَانًاۙ مَّوَدَّةَ بَيۡنِكُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ بِبَعۡضٍ وَّيَلۡعَنُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ بَعۡضًاؗ وَّمَاۡوٰىكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَࣗۖ‏
verses.en: And he said: "For you, ye have taken (for worship) idols besides Allah, out of mutual love and regard between yourselves in this life; but on the Day of Judgment ye shall disown each other and curse each other: and your abode will be the Fire, and ye shall have none to help

verses.ar: فَاٰمَنَ لَهٗ لُوۡطٌۘ وَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ مُهَاجِرٌ اِلٰي رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
verses.en: But Lut had faith in Him: He said: "I will leave home for the sake of my Lord: for He is Exalted in Might, and Wise

verses.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالۡكِتٰبَ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ اَجۡرَهٗ فِي الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَاِنَّهٗ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We gave (Abraham) Isaac and Jacob, and ordained among his progeny Prophethood and Revelation, and We granted him his reward in this life; and he was in the Hereafter (of the company) of the Righteous

verses.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّكُمۡ لَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الۡفَاحِشَةَؗ مَا سَبَقَكُمۡ بِهَا مِنۡ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And (remember) Lut: behold, he said to his people: "Ye do commit lewdness, such as no people in Creation (ever) committed before you

verses.ar: اَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُوۡنَ السَّبِيۡلَ ࣢ۙ وَتَاۡتُوۡنَ فِيۡ نَادِيۡكُمُ الۡمُنۡكَرَؕ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوا ائۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Do ye indeed approach men, and cut off the highway?- and practise wickedness (even) in your councils?" But his people gave no answer but this: they said: "Bring us the Wrath of Allah if thou tellest the truth

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ انۡصُرۡنِيۡ عَلَي الۡقَوۡمِ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: He said: "O my Lord! help Thou me against people who do mischief

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ بِالۡبُشۡرٰيۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا مُهۡلِكُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلِ هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةِۚ اِنَّ اَهۡلَهَا كَانُوۡا ظٰلِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: When Our Messengers came to Abraham with the good news, they said: "We are indeed going to destroy the people of this township: for truly they are (addicted to) crime

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ فِيۡهَا لُوۡطًاؕ قَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ فِيۡهَاؗ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهٗ وَاَهۡلَهٗ٘ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗؗ كَانَتۡ مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "But there is Lut there." They said: "Well do we know who is there: we will certainly save him and his following,- except his wife: she is of those who lag behind

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا٘ اَنۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوۡطًا سِيۡٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعًا وَّقَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡࣞ اِنَّا مُنَجُّوۡكَ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And when Our Messengers came to Lut, he was grieved on their account, and felt himself powerless (to protect) them: but they said: "Fear thou not, nor grieve: we are (here) to save thee and thy following, except thy wife: she is of those who lag behind

verses.ar: اِنَّا مُنۡزِلُوۡنَ عَلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِ هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡسُقُوۡنَ
verses.en: For we are going to bring down on the people of this township a Punishment from heaven, because they have been wickedly rebellious

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَا٘ اٰيَةًۭ بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We have left thereof an evident Sign, for any people who (care to) understand

verses.ar: وَاِلٰي مَدۡيَنَ اَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبًاۙ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَارۡجُوا الۡيَوۡمَ الۡاٰخِرَ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: To the Madyan (people) (We sent) their brother Shu'aib. Then he said: "O my people! serve Allah, and fear the Last Day: nor commit evil on the earth, with intent to do mischief

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الرَّجۡفَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَؗ‏
verses.en: But they rejected him: Then the mighty Blast seized them, and they lay prostrate in their homes by the morning

verses.ar: وَعَادًا وَّثَمُوۡدَا۠ وَقَدۡ تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّسٰكِنِهِمۡࣟ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡتَبۡصِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (Remember also) the 'Ad and the Thamud (people): clearly will appear to you from (the traces) of their buildings (their fate): the Evil One made their deeds alluring to them, and kept them back from the Path, though they were gifted with intelligence and skill

verses.ar: وَقَارُوۡنَ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَࣞ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰي بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانُوۡا سٰبِقِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: (Remember also) Qarun, Pharaoh, and Haman: there came to them Moses with Clear Signs, but they behaved with insolence on the earth; yet they could not overreach (Us)

verses.ar: فَكُلًّا اَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۭۡ بِهٖۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبًاۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَخَذَتۡهُ الصَّيۡحَةُۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَغۡرَقۡنَاۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Each one of them We seized for his crime: of them, against some We sent a violent tornado (with showers of stones); some were caught by a (mighty) Blast; some We caused the earth to swallow up; and some We drowned (in the waters): It was not Allah Who injured (or oppressed) them:" They injured (and oppressed) their own souls

verses.ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ الۡعَنۡكَبُوۡتِۚ اِتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتًاؕ وَاِنَّ اَوۡهَنَ الۡبُيُوۡتِ لَبَيۡتُ الۡعَنۡكَبُوۡتِۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: The parable of those who take protectors other than Allah is that of the spider, who builds (to itself) a house; but truly the flimsiest of houses is the spider's house;- if they but knew

verses.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
verses.en: Verily Allah doth know of (every thing) whatever that they call upon besides Him: and He is Exalted (in power), Wise

verses.ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡاَمۡثَالُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِۚ وَمَا يَعۡقِلُهَا٘ اِلَّا الۡعٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And such are the Parables We set forth for mankind, but only those understand them who have knowledge

verses.ar: خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Allah created the heavens and the earth in true (proportions): verily in that is a Sign for those who believe

verses.ar: اُتۡلُ مَا٘ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنَ الۡكِتٰبِ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَؕ اِنَّ الصَّلٰوةَ تَنۡهٰي عَنِ الۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَالۡمُنۡكَرِؕ وَلَذِكۡرُ اللّٰهِ اَكۡبَرُؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Recite what is sent of the Book by inspiration to thee, and establish regular Prayer: for Prayer restrains from shameful and unjust deeds; and remembrance of Allah is the greatest (thing in life) without doubt. And Allah knows the (deeds) that ye do

verses.ar: وَلَا تُجَادِلُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُؗ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ وَقُوۡلُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡنَا وَاُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ وَاِلٰهُنَا وَاِلٰهُكُمۡ وَاحِدٌ وَّنَحۡنُ لَهٗ مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And dispute ye not with the People of the Book, except with means better (than mere disputation), unless it be with those of them who inflict wrong (and injury): but say, "We believe in the revelation which has come down to us and in that which came down to you; Our Allah and your Allah is one; and it is to Him we bow (in Islam)

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمُ الۡكِتٰبَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖۚ وَمِنۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِهٖؕ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلَّا الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And thus (it is) that We have sent down the Book to thee. So the People of the Book believe therein, as also do some of these (pagan Arabs): and none but Unbelievers reject our signs

verses.ar: وَمَا كُنۡتَ تَتۡلُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ مِنۡ كِتٰبٍ وَّلَا تَخُطُّهٗ بِيَمِيۡنِكَ اِذًا لَّارۡتَابَ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And thou wast not (able) to recite a Book before this (Book came), nor art thou (able) to transcribe it with thy right hand: In that case, indeed, would the talkers of vanities have doubted

verses.ar: بَلۡ هُوَ اٰيٰتٌۭ بَيِّنٰتٌ فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَؕ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلَّا الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nay, here are Signs self-evident in the hearts of those endowed with knowledge: and none but the unjust reject Our Signs

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا الۡاٰيٰتُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: Ye they say: "Why are not Signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say: "The signs are indeed with Allah: and I am indeed a clear Warner

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ اَنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ يُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةً وَّذِكۡرٰي لِقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And is it not enough for them that we have sent down to thee the Book which is rehearsed to them? Verily, in it is Mercy and a Reminder to those who believe

verses.ar: قُلۡ كَفٰي بِاللّٰهِ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ شَهِيۡدًاۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوۡا بِاللّٰهِۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "Enough is Allah for a witness between me and you: He knows what is in the heavens and on earth. And it is those who believe in vanities and reject Allah, that will perish (in the end)

verses.ar: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِؕ وَلَوۡلَا٘ اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّي لَّجَآءَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ وَلَيَاۡتِيَنَّهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They ask thee to hasten on the Punishment (for them): had it not been for a term (of respite) appointed, the Punishment would certainly have come to them: and it will certainly reach them,- of a sudden, while they perceive not

verses.ar: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِؕ وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيۡطَةٌۭ بِالۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They ask thee to hasten on the Punishment: but, of a surety, Hell will encompass the Rejecters of Faith

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يَغۡشٰىهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِنۡ تَحۡتِ اَرۡجُلِهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: On the Day that the Punishment shall cover them from above them and from below them, and (a Voice) shall say: "Taste ye (the fruits) of your deeds

verses.ar: يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ اَرۡضِيۡ وَاسِعَةٌ فَاِيَّايَ فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
verses.en: O My servants who believe! truly, spacious is My Earth: therefore serve ye Me - (and Me alone)

verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِࣞ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Every soul shall have a taste of death in the end to Us shall ye be brought back

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ نِعۡمَ اَجۡرُ الۡعٰمِلِيۡنَࣗۖ‏
verses.en: But those who believe and work deeds of righteousness - to them shall We give a Home in Heaven,- lofty mansions beneath which flow rivers,- to dwell therein for aye;- an excellent reward for those who do (good)

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who persevere in patience, and put their trust, in their Lord and Cherisher

verses.ar: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَاؗࣗۖ اَللّٰهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَاِيَّاكُمۡؗۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: How many are the creatures that carry not their own sustenance? It is Allah who feeds (both) them and you: for He hears and knows (all things)

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُۚ فَاَنّٰي يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ
verses.en: If indeed thou ask them who has created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon (to his Law), they will certainly reply, "Allah". How are they then deluded away (from the truth)

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهٗؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: Allah enlarges the sustenance (which He gives) to whichever of His servants He pleases; and He (similarly) grants by (strict) measure, (as He pleases): for Allah has full knowledge of all things

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ نَّزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِهَا لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُؕ قُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And if indeed thou ask them who it is that sends down rain from the sky, and gives life therewith to the earth after its death, they will certainly reply, "Allah!" Say, "Praise be to Allah!" But most of them understand not

verses.ar: وَمَا هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا٘ اِلَّا لَهۡوٌ وَّلَعِبٌؕ وَاِنَّ الدَّارَ الۡاٰخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الۡحَيَوَانُۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: What is the life of this world but amusement and play? but verily the Home in the Hereafter,- that is life indeed, if they but knew

verses.ar: فَاِذَا رَكِبُوۡا فِي الۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ۚ فَلَمَّا نَجّٰىهُمۡ اِلَي الۡبَرِّ اِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Now, if they embark on a boat, they call on Allah, making their devotion sincerely (and exclusively) to Him; but when He has delivered them safely to (dry) land, behold, they give a share (of their worship to others)

verses.ar: لِيَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡۚۙ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوۡاࣟ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Disdaining ungratefully Our gifts, and giving themselves up to (worldly) enjoyment! But soon will they know

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَّيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡؕ اَفَبِالۡبَاطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do they not then see that We have made a sanctuary secure, and that men are being snatched away from all around them? Then, do they believe in that which is vain, and reject the Grace of Allah

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِالۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهٗؕ اَلَيۡسَ فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوًي لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And who does more wrong than he who invents a lie against Allah or rejects the Truth when it reaches him? Is there not a home in Hell for those who reject Faith

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ جٰهَدُوۡا فِيۡنَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَمَعَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And those who strive in Our (cause),- We will certainly guide them to our Paths: For verily Allah is with those who do right
